parsed.reason: The parent wants to be told when a spot opens in a full class but gave no link. The capability list says that without a link there is nothing to watch, and asking for the course-page link is the right answer, not a stall. The reply asks for exactly that in one short question, with nothing invented, no app referral and no greeting. A small blemish: the trailing question mark turns an ask into a slightly odd question form. It also does not say what happens next, that Hale will text when a spot shows, though that is implied by 'start watching'. Close to ideal.
